app.name: Stormfire
app.long_description:
Keep the campfire burning. Enemies march in from every side of the forest; build and upgrade five kinds of towers on the walls and blocks to stop them. Towers you place stay put.
Level 1, The Storm: a night of rain and lightning, ending with the Storm Golem. Level 2, Autumn Gold: golden hour in an autumn forest with armoured beetles, splitting slimes, sprinting foxes, crows and the Pumpkin King. Level 3, Hallows Eve: a foggy Halloween dusk where zombies and gravebreakers pound on your towers, ghosts fade out of reach, skeletons get back up, and the Ghoul King rises. Level 4, Dawn Isle: an island of old machines at sunrise - the sun climbs as the waves go by - with clockwork automatons, leaping springers, shielding brass moths, repairing tinkers, sentinels and the Architect. Level 5, Pirate Storm: a huge map all at sea in a storm. Pirates in rowboats, diving sharks, skull pirates, parrots and cannon-firing pirate ships sail in from eight directions for the treasure on the island in the middle - and then the Kraken rises. Everything rides the swell. Zoom with L / R. Level 6, 88 MPH: a time-travel town square at night. Visitors from the future arrive through time portals for the time machine in the middle - hoverboarders, drones, servo bots, holo-sharks, paradoxes, hover cars and the Time Train. 1.21 gigawatt lightning, 88 MPH time surges, and it plays like a pinball machine.
Every level has 20 waves and its own music.
Choose a level on the title screen with left / right.
Controls (Classic Controller): Left stick / D-Pad: move the cursor A: build / upgrade B: sell ZL / ZR: choose tower L / R: zoom out / in Y: fast forward X: call the next wave early (bonus gold) +: pause (music / sound on-off, restart, quit) -: 16:9 / 4:3 screen HOME: exit
